MOTIF_DECOMPOSITION.ARITHMETIC: Eliminating alert-introducing edits entirely would move mean per-edit dQED from -0.0837 to -0.0454 -- about 46% of the damage removed, still negative.
MOTIF_DECOMPOSITION.READING: A handful of motifs -- peroxide, hydrazine, N-O -- carry roughly 3x the damage and about 40% of edits, and they are exactly what shows up by eye in both the reward-hacked gsk3b endpoints (`[IH]OOCNNCO`) and the parent-first construction output (`N#CCNOCO`, `OOC1NC=C(Cl)C=C1Br`). A prior trained on real molecules should suppress them nearly for free, since drug corpora barely contain them. BUT alert-free edits are STILL net-negative at -0.045 with a 60% loss rate, so motif suppression is not the whole answer and a SMARTS blacklist would capture at most half the benefit while adding a hand-tuned rule set. The remaining damage is broad off-manifold drift and needs genuine distributional modelling -- which is the argument for doing the learned prior properly rather than shortcutting it.
MOTIF_DECOMPOSITION.question: How much of the per-edit damage is a few identifiable bad motifs, versus broad off-manifold drift?

PREDICTION: Under a model-weighted draw, mean per-edit dQED should move materially toward 0 (or positive) and the 66.1% loss rate should fall. That is measurable on replayed parents at zero oracle cost and is a sharper test than the aggregate median-QED prediction, because it is per-edit and attributable.
READING_1_no_single_bad_operator: EVERY family is net-negative, spanning -0.055 to -0.171. So this is not one pathological operator to disable -- it is what random selection from the legal fiber does. The drug-like manifold is a thin subset of the legal fiber, so a random legal move leaves it. This is the predicted consequence of having no prior, measured at the level of individual edits.
READING_2_damage_scales_with_program_len: 1-2 primitive actions cost -0.027 QED; 9 actions cost -0.195, about 7x. Each additional unguided step is another weighted coin flip against drug-likeness. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE STRUCTURAL-JUMP WORK: pushing toward larger coherent programs WITHOUT a chemical prior actively makes chemistry worse. Coherence must arrive together with chemistry, or bigger is simply worse.
READING_3_the_signal_exists_and_is_unuse: 33.9% of edits do NOT lose QED. A prior does not need to invent good moves -- it needs to prefer the third of legal moves that already preserve or improve chemistry. That is a ranking problem over an existing support, which is why weighting the draw is the right shape of fix and a post-hoc QED/SA filter is not.
method: For every archive entry of the completed 3x250 run, decode_state(source_state) -> parent SMILES, compare QED/SA/heavy against the recorded endpoint, and attribute to the model_family set of the executed trace actions. 702 parent->child edits across three tasks.
